name: Season record
description: THE MEMBER'S COPY of soma-pub-record: the same statement with the session's claims, so a private season answers to whoever season_visible() lets see it. Uncached, because the answer depends on the viewer. A closed season's whole record as one document: the season as it closed, what rated it (the plugin's digest and its parameters), the columns, every ladder's standings in rank order, the podium and every version's ratings -- written by the close and never recomputed, so an archive of it is the season for ever. season_cache: a record never changes. 404 for an unknown game or season; 409 season_open for a live one, which has no record yet.

with.name: A live season has no record yet
